description: Describe a tileset so you can choose tiles to paint: which image is assigned to each sheet (A1-A5, B-E), the tile id ranges, and for autotile sheets every kind with its type, position on the sheet image and passability. Without `sheet` you get an overview; pass `sheet` for the detail of one sheet (for A5/B-E that includes a passability grid laid out like the image: o passable, x blocked, * drawn above characters, p partly blocked). Use get_tileset_image to see what the tiles look like. `tileIds` decodes passability and terrain flags for specific tile ids.

sheet.description: Return the detail of one sheet

tilesetId.description: Tileset id (a map's tilesetId, see get_map)

name: get_tileset_info
title: Get tileset info
